welcome.title: Welcome to Logia
welcome.desc: Logia helps you organize and track your media collections. This quick tour will guide you through creating your first collection and adding a media item. Let's get started!

goToLibrary.title: Go to your Library
goToLibrary.desc: Click "Library" in the navigation bar to access your collections.

libraryNewCollection.title: Create a collection
libraryNewCollection.desc: Hover over the collection bar: a "+" button will appear automatically. Click it to create your first collection.

collectionName.title: Name your collection
collectionName.desc: Give it a clear name such as Movies, Series, Manga, or Books.

collectionDynamicIntro.title: Dynamic fields
collectionDynamicIntro.desc: Customize the labels displayed throughout the app. Instead of generic terms like 'Creator' or 'Date', each collection adapts to its content ('Author' for books, 'Director' for movies, etc.).

collectionCreator.title: The creator label
collectionCreator.desc: This field defines how the creator is named, for instance 'Author' for books, 'Director' for movies, or 'Studio' for series.

collectionDates.title: Date fields
collectionDates.desc: Customize your date labels for first-time experiences and re-reads/re-watches, such as 'Read date' and 'Re-read date'.

collectionProgression.title: The progression label
collectionProgression.desc: Define your progression unit: 'Episode' for series, 'Chapter' for books, or 'Volume' for manga. The short label is used in compact views.

collectionAdvanced.title: Advanced options
collectionAdvanced.desc: Customize total duration (e.g. 'Runtime' or 'Pages'), consumption verbs for goals, and an optional monthly target.

collectionVisual.title: Visual customization
collectionVisual.desc: Preview your collection layout live. Choose a color and icon to quickly identify your collection in the library.

collectionSave.title: Save your collection
collectionSave.desc: Click Save to create your collection. You can update these settings at any time.

libraryAddMedia.title: Add your first media
libraryAddMedia.desc: Click "New" to create your first media item in this collection.

mediaCollectionDropdown.title: Choosing a collection
mediaCollectionDropdown.desc: Select which collection your media belongs to, or create a new collection directly from this menu.

mediaTitle.title: Name your media
mediaTitle.desc: Enter the media title. This is one of the few required fields alongside collection selection.

mediaCreator.title: The creator
mediaCreator.desc: Enter the author, director, or studio. Automatic suggestions will appear as you type.

mediaStatusDate.title: Status and release date
mediaStatusDate.desc: Set your media's current status (upcoming, in progress, completed) and official release date.

mediaSynopsis.title: The synopsis
mediaSynopsis.desc: Write a description or summary. Markdown formatting is supported to structure your content.

mediaCover.title: Cover preview
mediaCover.desc: This card previews the cover image. Images added in the Gallery section below serve as cover artwork.

mediaGenres.title: Genres
mediaGenres.desc: Assign genres to organize your media and refine recommendations for similar content.

mediaProgress.title: Progress
mediaProgress.desc: Track your progress with current status, episode/chapter count, and total count. Keep a log of rewatches or re-reads.

mediaReview.title: Detailed review
mediaReview.desc: Write a detailed review with Markdown, or insert a pre-defined review template.

mediaRating.title: Rating and pros/cons
mediaRating.desc: Score your experience out of 100 and list positive and negative highlights.

mediaGallery.title: Image gallery
mediaGallery.desc: Add up to 12 images per media via drag-and-drop or clipboard, then easily reorder them.

mediaAttachments.title: Attached files
mediaAttachments.desc: Attach complementary files such as game saves, ebooks, or archives to keep everything together.

mediaCreate.title: Create your first media
mediaCreate.desc: Review your information and save. You're all set!
